cells.location: CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / RAJAMPET TALUK · CUDDAPAH DISTRICT / RAJAMPET TALUK † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Records an endowment of 40 paṇam entrusted into the hands of the Sthānapatis of the temple of Pāvaṇāśamuḍaiya-nāyaṇār for the daily supply of rice for offerings to the god out of the interest accrued on the endowed amount by Puśanadēvaṉ Āḷvāṉ of Magaraḷ.

cells.location: GODAVARI, WEST, DISTRICT / TANUKU TALUK · GODAVARI, WEST, DISTRICT / TANUKU TALUK † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: States that the image was given by a certain Kamala Jan-nayya to (god) Pratāpariya of Maṇḍapāka. In late cha-racters.

cells.location: HYDERABAD DISTRICT · HYDERABAD DISTRICT — Telangana

cells.date: Chālukya Vikrama . . . [Su]bhakrīt (wrong for Plava), Phālguna-amāvās-yā, Friday, solar eclipse. Probably =1122 A.D., March 10.
cells.remarks: Confers the right of administration over the villages Māduvula in Kukkaçamu-30 and Abbulūru in Nāmanikamī-70 respectively on Bhīmana-Peggaça, the son-in-law of Kāmana-Peggaça and the former's son Doddaya Bhatta by Mahāmandalēšvara Kandūri Gōkarṇa Chōça-mahārāja.

cells.location: Gobbur, Devadurg Taluk, Raichur District. — Karnataka
cells.date: Year 13, Sarvajit, Śrāvaṇa śu. 5, Thursday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of incomes from several tolls for worship, offerings, etc., to god Chennakēšava of the agrahāra Hiriya-Gobbūru, consecrated by Śripati-setīi, by the Five-hundred svāmis of Ayyāvoje, and the nānādēśis of Ayyanavāçi-300, headed by Būchi-setīi and others. Also records further gift by the body of One-Thousand, the Hannavanigas, the nakharas, the officers of the mint and several others to the same deity.

cells.location: Gobbur, Devadurg Taluk, Raichur District. — Karnataka
cells.date: Chālukya Vikrama 33, Sarvadhāri, Māgha Puṇṇame, Monday, lunar eclipse=1109 A.D., January 18. But there was no eclipse on that day.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of money for the various deities, obviously of Gobbur, by the Two-Hundred mahājanas of Hiriya-Gobbur, with the permission of Daṇḍanāyaka Anantapāla. Records also several gifts of money to certain individuals connected with the temple. Cf. No. 21 below.

cells.location: Gobbur, Devadurg Taluk, Raichur District. — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Records a gift of eleven mattar of land in rājadhāni Priya-Mosangi by the king to the temple of Vishnu built by Kēśavabhaṭṭa, at the instance of Peggaḍa Mādinayya.

cells.location: Gobbur, Devadurg Taluk, Raichur District. — Karnataka
cells.date: Śaka 949, Prabhava, Pushya, ba. 1[0], Sunday, Uttarāyaṇa-saṅkrānti=1027 A.D., December 24, f.d.t.·55.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land, oil-mill and flower garden in rājadhāni Priya-Mosangi by Jagadēkamalla’s Sōmaladēvi, daughter of Jagadēkamalla, when she was staying at the appayaṇa-sīda Palipodaru, to the basadi built by the queen at the instance of Sōdarēyavara Rēvaṇayya. Published in Hyd. Arch. Ser., No. 18, pp. 42-43.

cells.location: ANDHRA / HYDERABAD DISTRICT · ANDHRA—contd. / HYDERABAD DISTRICT—contd. / Hyderabad—contd. — Telangana

cells.remarks: Top portion broken and lost. Records the construction of a temple of god Svayambhu Dakshina-Sōmanātha and gifts of land, oil-mill and house sites, etc., to the same after receiving them from the mannya and the ūroḍeya by Sōvaya-nāyaka, son of Boppa-nāyaka. Also records the gifts of land, oil, and ghee for the lamps to the temple and for the priests and other temple servants, by the nakhara, nānādeśi, heṇjanjus and the Ona-Thousand.

cells.location: ANDHRA / HYDERABAD DISTRICT · ANDHRA—contd. / HYDERABAD DISTRICT—contd. / Hyderabad—contd. † — Telangana

cells.remarks: Lower portion lost. Records a gift of land to Gārgya Hari-hara-bhaṭṭa, son of Gōndamayya-daṇḍanāyaka and the śrōtriyens of Chēvūru. Also records another gift of land to Gōvinda-ghaḷḷasa. Other details of the second gift are lost.

cells.location: ANDHRA / HYDERABAD DISTRICT · ANDHRA—contd. / HYDERABAD DISTRICT—contd. / Hyderabad—contd. † — Telangana
cells.remarks: Middle portion of the front side of the slab is completely worn out. Mentions Kumāra Sōmēśvaradēva and the god Kēśavadēva. Seems to refer to the income of some king, from taxes, etc., to the latter.

cells.location: ANDHRA / HYDERABAD DISTRICT · ANDHRA—contd. / HYDERABAD DISTRICT—contd. / Hyderabad—contd. — Telangana
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit; Kannada and Nāgari.

cells.location: ANDHRA / HYDERABAD DISTRICT · ANDHRA—contd. / HYDERABAD DISTRICT—contd. / Hyderabad—contd. — Telangana
cells.date: Chālukya Vikrama 33, Sarvadhāri, Māgha paurṇami, Monday, lunar eclipse=1109 A.D., January 18. There was no eclipse on that day.
cells.remarks: Records gift of money at specified rates by the nakhara, the officers of the mint, (Kaṇṇamaḍa-adhikārigalu) and the Kaṇṇakaḍāras of Agrahāra Gōbbūru, to the Brahmā Jinalaya for conducting the Chaitra-pavitra. Cf. No. 14 above.

cells.location: ANDHRA / HYDERABAD DISTRICT · ANDHRA—contd. / HYDERABAD DISTRICT—contd. / Hyderabad—contd. — Telangana
cells.date: Year 10, Durmukhi, Chaitra śu. 1, Monday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Records gift of oil from one oil-mill and land to god Basanta-kallēśvara, consecrated by Madhusūdana-bhaṭṭōpādhyāya by the mahājanas of agrahāra Hirya-Gōbbūru. Registers also further gifts of land and income from taxes by several officials and other individuals.

cells.location: ANDHRA / HYDERABAD DISTRICT · ANDHRA—contd. / HYDERABAD DISTRICT—contd. / Hyderabad—contd. — Telangana
cells.date: Year 9, Ānanda, Āshāḍha amā-vāsye, Thursday (wrong for Monday), solar eclipse=1134 A.D., July 23.
cells.remarks: Top portion broken and lost. Records a gift of land purchased from Raviyana and others, money and a house-site for worship and offerings to god Sōmanāthadēva by the Mānneya, Mallidēvarasa, the prabhus and the māḷigas. The record mentions that a temple was constructed in praise of Madirāja who seems to have been responsible for the construction of the temple.

cells.location: ANDHRA / HYDERABAD DISTRICT · ANDHRA—contd. / HYDERABAD DISTRICT—contd. / Hyderabad—contd. † — Telangana
cells.date: Śaka 1438, Dhātu, Jyaishṭha śu. 3, Sunday 1516 A.D., May 4.
cells.remarks: Records remission of dues payable on rōṇḍu, kūṭamuṇḍu, bōṇḍlu, etc. to the government and gift of some land in addition to that formerly endowed to the same deity at Koṇḍapalli under the orders of Rāyasam Koṇḍamarusayya. Parvatayya set up the record.

cells.location: ANDHRA / KARIMNAGAR DISTRICT / MANTHANI TALUK · KARIMNAGAR DISTRICT / MANTHANI TALUK — Telangana
cells.remarks: States that the image of Bhagavatī was made by Bē[ṭa]na, son of Nāgayu and was consecrated by Ekkala-māmuni. In characters of about the 8th century.

cells.location: KRISHNA DISTRICT / GANNAVARAM TALUK · KRISHNA DISTRICT / GANNAVARAM TALUK — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: States that mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Jagadala Chaṭṭadēvarasa gave the village Kummūr to the temple of god Kēdāra, taking two-hundred gadyāṇas from the latter who granted a grant of land, garden and oil-mill, for the worship of the god, Ramānātha, after having the feet of Kēdāra-paṇḍita.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / BYADGI TALUK · Māsaṅgi — Karnataka
cells.date: Year [15?], Raudri, Āśvija ba. 5, Monday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Refers to an attack on Guṭṭarasa of Guṭṭioḷal and to the death in the fight of Māḷadēva, son of Kagga-gauḍa, the nālprabhu of Māsaṅgi.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / BYADGI TALUK · Māsaṅgi — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Commemorates the death of Ammaṇa in a fight with anniga when Kammayya was governing the nāḍu and Malluga was the vaḍḍaravōḷa of Bāsavūra-140, and records a grant of land to Brega, the sculptor of the stone and also to another individual named Asagayya.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / BYADOI TALUK · Muṭṭūr — Karnataka

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / BYADOI TALUK · Muṭṭūr — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a grant of land and house-site by the people of Maṭṭūre to Asagara Kālēya in appreciation of his services in a cattle raid.

cells.remarks: Records a grant of land by Jaggi-gāvunda of Goṭṭagaḍi, Kāmka-gāvunda and others to Hallige, the elder brother of Kammāra Mācha who died in a fight when Jakki-seṭṭi of Kammanavalli attacked the village Muṭṭūr.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / BYADOI TALUK · Muṭṭūr — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the death of a hero in a fight and refers to a grant of land. Other details are lost. In characters of about the 14th century.

cells.remarks: Registers gifts of land, oil and oil-mill for a perpetual lamp and for worship and offerings in the temple of Mallikārjunadēva by tantrapāla Lakumana-nāyaka and his sons and nephews who were responsible also for the construction of the temple and of a tank called Āśvarasamudra while they were in charge of Kiriya-Hananije, a sivata of Hallavura, as the feudatories of mahāmandalēśvara Āśvaradēva of the Sinda family who was administering Eđevatta-70, Baļave70 and other divisions from his capital at Hallavura-belagavartti. States that mahāpradhāna Kāmana-Sōmana-Kēsirāja-daṇdanāyaka was governing Banavāśi-12000 from his capital at Baļligāve.

cells.place: Hero-stone lying in the compound of Kallappaṇagaḍi.

(Cf. No. 454 above.

cells.remarks: Records a gift of perggade-koḍige-padyāna collected by the ḍaḷigas, to god Jakkēśvara, at the instance of the 1000 ūroḍeyas and other chiefs of Piriya Kāreyūr by Guṇḍamarasa who was the prabhu and herggaḍe of agrahāra. Koṇḍaguṇḍi which is situated at the west of Kiankāḍu-70. Also records a gift of money by Taḍiga Masanaya-nāyaka and his diya Māleya, and of oil by the other ḍaḷigas when mahāpradhāna sēnādhipati, māneverggaḍe Sāvipayya, was administering Banavāsi-12000.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions daṇḍanāyaka Rudramaraṇa and other officers (name lost), and agrahāra Hiriyakērūru. Other details are lost.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Records the death of a nāyaka, probably in an encounter with a tiger. Mentions....muḍugansahali and Hirivake[reyūru]. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.remarks: States that Bāchi-gavuđa, son of mūliga Sōma-gavuđa and disciple of rājaguru Mūrjāvidēva, a devotee of god Kađanibēšvara, died in a fight, within the boundary of Kađavūr and that 20 kanma of land was granted by the ārādkya. Cf. No. 46S above.

cells.location: MYSORE · Kāluvihaḷḷi — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Seems to state that the pillar was set up by Basavaṇṇa who was a devotee of god Basavaṇṇa. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE · Makari — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab called nēgilakallu set up near the steps of the hoṇḍa.
cells.remarks: Refers to the rule of Prithuvī-Māra over Banavāsi-12000 and of Sindaka Vīra over another territory (name not clear) and seems to record the death of some person. Cf. No. 479 below.

cells.location: MYSORE · Maḷige — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone set up at the entrance of the Śaṅkaraliṅga temple.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land as umbaḷi for the worship of god Śaṅkaraliṅga of Maḷige by [Kṛi]shṇāji-panta. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE · Nūlgēri — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Seems to state that Kundavasi and Ajākeyya made a gift of land and had the mēḷi set up while Mārake-arasa was governing Banavāsi-12000. Balmāḷcha made the mēḷi. Published in Progress Report of the Kannada Research Institute, Dharwar, for 1953-57, p. 68, No. 5. Cf. No. 479 below.

cells.location: MYSORE · Nīlgiri † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Seems to state that Emmeyara Rēcha had some Brāhmaṇa families from Kereyūr settled in the locality. Kalimitra wrote the record. Ibid., pp. 23-74, No. 11.

cells.location: MYSORE · Śiragambi — Karnataka
cells.place: Base of the image in the Bharamappa temple to the east of the village.
cells.remarks: Broken and damaged. Refers to [Bā]chaya, son of mahāpradhāna Kumāra [Ba]mmaṇarasa. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar by the side of the Māruti temple.
cells.remarks: Top right corner is broken. Seems to refer to the setting up of a mēḷi. Māra is stated to be administering the nāḍu. Mentions Geṇḍavana and the 95 prajes. [Nāga] made the pillar. In characters of about the 9th-10th century. Cf. Nos. 474 and 476 above.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE — Karnataka
cells.place: cond. DHARWAR DISTRICT—cond. HIREKERUR TALUK—cond. Śiragāmbi—cond. Slab by the side of the Mīrati temple
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 12 mattar of land as biltuvaṭṭa for the upkeep of the local tank while Rēchiga was in charge of the ūr and Lōkayya was administering Banavāsi-12000. Paratavara Māramma is mentioned. Published in Progress Report of the Kannada Research Institute, Dharwar, for 1953-57, p. 73, No. 10.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab kept in the shrine of Mallinātha temple.
cells.remarks: The bottom portion is peeled off. The extant portion refers to Bhuvanakamalla-Vīra-Noḷamba Uṇayiditya as governing Banavāsi-12000 and Sattalige-1000 divisions. Also refers to the gaṇḍuḍas of Śiragāmbi which was situated in Raṭṭapāḷi-70.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab called Nēgila-kallu set up by the side of the house of H.K. Soratur.
cells.remarks: States that Gendavanna died being pierced (?) by the plough-share. In characters of about the 9th-10th century. Cf. No. 479 above.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab called Vīragallu set up in the field of M.B. Gabbi.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 6 matter of land to god Beḷḍēva by Apallabbe, wife of Gōvinda-gāvuṇḍa who was governing Banavāsi-12000 while Ammasa and three others were administering Tiri-gamme as gāvuṇḍas. Also records another gift of 4 matter of land to the same deity on a later date by Lokabbe, wife of Avareavasa who was administering Tirigamme while the four gāvuṇḍas were ruling. Refers to the gift-making karaṇas, and Rājāditya-arasa was governing Banavāsi-12000. The gift land was made over to Nigaṇṭandi, the disciple of Boḷḷavisāda-guṇavar, with the consent of the people of Tirigamme, and Tīrthakara Bhaṭṭāra was engraved on the record on the stone which bears the figure of a Jina at the top. Published in Progress Report of Kannada Research Institute, Dharwar, for 1953-57, pp. 69-70, No. 6.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE † — Karnataka

Contains the genealogies of Taila III and Nācharasa. Cf. No. 499 above.

cells.location: MYSORE · Tēṅgli † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Records certain gifts of land after purchase by Chaṇḍimarasa, the prabhu of Tenguli and his son Nāchayya to gods Chaṇḍēśvara, Sōmēśvara, Sōmanāthadēva, Mallikārjunadēva and Bhōgēśvara-dēva and some individuals. Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Vīra-Gomkarasa (I) of the Bāṇa family is mentioned as the ruler of Khāṇḍava-maṇḍala and as the overlord of Chaṇḍimarasa. Cf. No. 512 above.

cells.location: MYSORE · Tēṅgli † — Karnataka

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE — Karnataka

cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama 31, Vyaya, Chaitra śu. 13, Thursday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Records that Kechohamayāṇitya-Bhaṭṭopādhyāya and his wife Dēviyakka constructed a temple at Tengli, installed the image of Mallikārjuna and, with the permission of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Bībbarasa, made gifts for the worship of the god and for the maintenance of the temple. Also records that the donor's eldest son, Peḍḍavēchi-Bhaṭṭōpādhyāya and his wife Sāvitriyakka made a gift of land and a garden for the temple. Further states that his brother Kēśavadēva-bhaṭṭa and his wife Malliyakka made another gift of land and a house from their holding to the same temple.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Gives the genealogy of the Chālukyas from Jayasiṁha I. Records that on this date the queen Mailaladēvī made a permanent grant of the two villages Sonnavāḍa, situated in Manne-30 in Maṇṇadēśadēśa and Paṭṭavāḍe, to a number of Brāhmaṇas belonging to different gōtras and śākhās.

cells.location: MYSORE · MYSORE † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: States that on finding that the grant made in No. 516 above was insufficient, the queen made a further grant of five villages (names not given) on this date from the camp on the banks of the Tapi river. Cf. No. 516 above.

cells.location: MYSORE / SHORAPUR TALUK · SHORAPUR TALUK Mudanūr — Karnataka

cells.location: MYSORE / SHORAPUR TALUK · SHORAPUR TALUK Mudanūr † — Karnataka

cells.location: MYSORE / SHORAPUR TALUK · SHORAPUR TALUK Mudanūr — Karnataka

States that the mammāridanda and other lands in a village were newly and renewed the above grant, probably on a later date.

cells.remarks: Records a grant of land for worship and offerings to god Laksh-mīśvara by the mahājanas of agrahāra Mudinūr. The grant was entrusted to Ballajja, the sthānīka of the place.

cells.location: MYSORE / SHORAPUR TALUK · SHORAPUR TALUK Mudanūr † — Karnataka

The grant was made in the Kōḍi-kammaṭa (workshop) (at the temple) of māhēśvara Sambhuvanna. Further records grants of money by the Billa-three-hundred and the prabhus and gāvuṇḍas of Morata-Three-hundred. Also records grant of land and a house-site to Sambhuvanna, the mason Timmōja and the carpenter Mallōja.

cells.remarks: States that when Mallidevarasa was camping at Ayyans, Sōmadeva with his chief queen Mākāladēvi, their three sons, Sōbhana-dēva, Bamma-dēva, Mallidēva and his wife, chief queen Mālāyā, described as the dūtī of god Saptamālikā of Morata installed god Sakalēśvara in the name of Mādirajayya and that Basavaladēvi, Mālāyā's daughter and the wife of Mallarasa made a grant of land for god Mālēśvaradēva. Mallarasa was a son of the Haihaya king Bijja of Modegamūr and to have defeated a certain Hadiga and a general of Bhillama. Cf. Nos. 555 and 556 above.
